hypothesis: The frozen R7 learned causal error-basis directions remain transferable to the r4 epoch-7 parent and will improve mean future relative L2 by at least 0.5 percent on the same three-record train smoke after old-parent thresholds are removed.
single_change_vs_confirmed_r7: parent checkpoint transfer; basis weights and defect contract unchanged; calibration thresholds deliberately removed
primary_metric: mean per-record future full-field relative-L2 improvement after adaptation sealing

rollback: Zero correction returns the exact r4 parent. The original frozen R7 checkpoint remains untouched.
